Applications must be submitted online on or before 06-10-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.

Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.

Pay the application fee online, if applicable.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Ratan Tata Maharashtra State Skills University (RTMSSU) for filling specialized contractual positions in the education sector in Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised under advt no RTMSSU/2026/NT/03?
faq.answer: The advertised position is Senior Consultant - Innovation under advertisement number RTMSSU/2026/NT/03, intended for experienced professionals in innovation and entrepreneurship management.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Consultant - Innovation post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Senior Consultant - Innovation position, making it a highly competitive recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for RTMSSU recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted exclusively through the online mode via the official career portal of Ratan Tata Maharashtra State Skills University before the closing date.

faq.question: Q5. When did the application process start?
faq.answer: The online application process for the RTMSSU Senior Consultant - Innovation position commenced on 29 September 2026 along with the release of the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to submit the online application form?
faq.answer: The final date to submit the completed online application form along with necessary details is 06 October 2026 until 18:15 Hours.

faq.question: Q7. What educational qualifications are required to apply?
faq.answer: Applicants must possess a Master’s degree in Event Management, Engineering, Technology, Entrepreneurship, Innovation, Design, or a related discipline from a recognized University or Institution.

faq.question: Q8. How much professional experience is required for this role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a minimum of 8 to 10 years of relevant professional experience in innovation, entrepreneurship, incubation, start-ups, industry collaboration, or technology management.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for RTMSSU Senior Consultant?
faq.answer: The selection process generally involves short-listing of aspirants, an optional written examination, document verification, and a personal interview conducted by the university committee.

faq.question: Q10. Where can candidates apply for this job?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply by visiting the official university career website at https://mssu.ac.in/careers-2/ and filling out the application form without leaving any mandatory fields blank.
